scope: STOP audit before any candidate; not an execution or concurrency proof

rowReads.rows: The requested result basis and every supersedes_id ancestor, cycle checked
rowReads.writerInvariant: All inserted fields are server-owned. Supersede only sets status/row_version/updated_at/updated_by, with expected version. No supported in-place edit of reason/creator/creation/effective date.

rowReads.rows: Every project peer for each current or ancestor basis, plus predecessor peer identity/time
rowReads.writerInvariant: Replacement supersede and operating inclusion both advance row_version with updated_at. Creation/effective date, creator, predecessor and frozen economics are not edited by those writers.

rowReads.rows: All physical source members of each basis, equal to the complete nonempty frozen source set
rowReads.writerInvariant: Source rows are inserted once; the only supported mutation is is_current=false, included in the factual payload hash. No timestamp edit. Optional updated_at/effective_at are absent in the registered row constructor.

rowReads.rows: Actual latest source Costs; ancestor economics come from frozen source_payload, not a guessed current Cost
rowReads.writerInvariant: Creation is server-generated once. E replacement, F stage handling and G inclusion advance the hashed row_version with updated_at; source economics/history are preserved or get a new PK. No supported timestamp-only edit.

rowReads.rows: Actual governance_evidence_id for each basis and every peer result, including ancestors
rowReads.writerInvariant: evidence::persist inserts a new row; there is no supported update/delete path in the producer. reference version is constant 1, while target/payload/hash/reason/actor/project are factual-hashed. No claim of a physical immutable trigger.

capturedReads.authority: The entire source_payload and entire Evidence.frozen_payload are hashed by existing Catalog references, not only the fields listed below.
indirectPureFunctions: sources::reference -> registered factual_payload whitelist for the same five actual row families
project_actual_cost::compare_source_transition -> the already-hashed captured original/current objects, no fresh DB source fetch
allocation_decimal/total_layers/allocate_source_layers -> exact immutable money and share payload inputs, no DB/OS reads

lockAndCAS.sourceSelection: store::project_predicate recursively follows basis supersedes_id and selects all peer results, sources, source Costs and governance Evidence, without foreign pruning
lockAndCAS.rowLock: sources::lock_full_source_set invokes store::lock_family_rows for all five families; exact row-id or basis/cost composite PK FOR UPDATE
lockAndCAS.projectLock: service.rs locks every discovered project before collect; F allocation locks source/current/new-share projects before replacement
lockAndCAS.ordering: collector performs full-family lock, actual source reload/merge, repeated project discovery and expectedInputHash check before governed writes; final collection reload follows same locked session
lockAndCAS.timestampHashing: Restatement hashes source identities/versions/factual payloads, not all transport timestamps. Only FirstPeriod explicitly adds input_evidence temporal data.
lockAndCAS.writerClosedSufficiency: Within the fixed supported Rust public writer closure, all unhashed values consulted by qualification are insert-only or advance a hashed row version/current marker. No supported timestamp-only or creator/reason/request rewrite was found. This is not a claim that arbitrary privileged SQL is constrained by those public writers.

ancestryAndAdoption.missingOrCorrupt: The existing qualifier fails on missing basis/peer/member/evidence, predecessor inconsistency or bad observations; no historical metadata is filled or inferred.
ancestryAndAdoption.legacyFuture: Unknown legacy future batches remain blocked. The gate authorizes exclusion only after full positive proof; it does not adopt or relabel legacy data.
ancestryAndAdoption.inWindow: The proposed in-window path will not invoke the FirstPeriod qualifier or gain these new temporal constraints.

conclusion: Technically sufficient under the fixed supported public-writer closure and existing row/project locks; direct field-level temporal hash coverage does not exist. Root/Final must confirm this bounded premise before resuming candidate creation.
